blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Что такое ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., past m. sg.) генерал?
exercises.why: **нес** — past tense (masculine) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Телегу мы сами ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., past pl.).
exercises.why: **везли** — past tense (plural) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Нянька ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., past f. sg.) за ней Федю.
exercises.why: **несла** — past tense (feminine) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: В гимназию его ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 1st pl.).
exercises.why: **везем** — present tense (1st person plural) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Тех он, кто ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., past m. sg.) кирпичи!
exercises.why: **нёс** — past tense (masculine) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Дорога ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., past f. sg.) в деревню.
exercises.why: **вела** — past tense (feminine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: От него ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., past n. sg.) Достоевским.
exercises.why: **несло** — past tense (neuter) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Мать ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., past f. sg.) его за руку.
exercises.why: **вела** — past tense (feminine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Сам Гнедко ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., past m. sg.) Тёму.
exercises.why: **вёз** — past tense (masculine) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Кого ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)? — спросили они.
exercises.why: **несете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Ведь карательный ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 1st pl.).
exercises.why: **везем** — present tense (1st person plural) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., imper. pl.) меня, нечего тут.
exercises.why: **везите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Коломенку ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., past n. sg.) очень скоро.
exercises.why: **несло** — past tense (neuter) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Но Давыд и ухом не ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., past m. sg.)!
exercises.why: **вёл** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Выше бережка головушку ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.).
exercises.why: **несёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Ребёнка пленного он ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., past m. sg.).
exercises.why: **вёз** — past tense (masculine) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Ну, за пятиалтынный ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **везёте** — present tense (2nd person plural) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Команду ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., past m. sg.) один поручик.
exercises.why: **вёл** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., imper. pl.) его, Николай Иваныч!
exercises.why: **везите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Куда вы теперь меня ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?.
exercises.why: **везёте** — present tense (2nd person plural) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).
